tools.name: check_memory
tools.description: Before a heavy job, send how much memory the machine your agent runs on has free (free -m, os.freemem()) and what you are about to run. Get a memory warning and a verdict: run_local, or offload with the provider to use. Free watch-only logs would_offload for the weekly report; nothing runs.

tools.name: run_job
tools.description: Pro: run a shell command in a fresh cloud sandbox on your own provider account (vercel (Vercel Sandbox, default), e2b, daytona, modal, workers (Workers Sandbox)) and get the exit code and the last 16 KB of stdout and stderr back. Send small input files with it. The sandbox is created for the job and

tools.name: save_provider_key
tools.description: Pro, owner only: save one provider key, sealed with AES-256-GCM before it reaches the database. Providers: vercel (Vercel Sandbox, default), e2b, daytona, modal, workers (Workers Sandbox). Vercel needs team_id and project_id; Modal and Workers Sandbox need bridge_url (see provider_setup). The key is

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Every provider this connects to, how each one runs, and (with your key) the provider keys you saved: name, provider, fingerprint, default, last used. Never shows a key.

tools.name: delete_provider_key
tools.description: Pro, owner only: delete a saved provider key by name. Jobs on that key stop working at once.

tools.name: provider_setup
tools.description: Step-by-step setup for one provider: where to get the key, what to pass to save_provider_key, links to its docs and price page, and for Modal or Workers Sandbox the bridge code to deploy on your own account.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Plain-English summary of the last 7 days: memory checks, low-memory warnings, jobs that would have been offloaded (free) or ran (Pro) by provider, minutes and failures. Read-only; sends nothing. Needs an API key.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $9/month upgrade link. Free tier: 500 calls/day. Not metered.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "run_job" appears informational but accepts parameters (cmd, env) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: cmd, provider, files, env, timeout_s, runtime, template, free_mb
